review_method: Parsed each boss's full db/re/mob_skill_db.conf block (including val0-val4, not just val0) and traced NPC_SUMMONMONSTER/NPC_SUMMONSLAVE handling through src/map/skill.c's case and src/map/mob.c's mob_summonslave to confirm which fields are the summon candidate list versus the summon amount, and cross-checked MSC_* cast-condition semantics against mob_use_skill/mob_use_skill_event in src/map/mob.c. Summon candidate and skill-trigger IDs were resolved against docs/bestiary.v1.json and db/re/skill_db.conf.

entries.title: Amon Ra's counter-summons and self-heal

summons.trigger: Hit by a long-range (non-magic) physical attack (MSC_LONGRANGEATTACKED), becoming the target of a cast (MSC_CASTTARGETED), or a player using Fire Wall/MG_FIREWALL, Storm Gust/WZ_STORMGUST, Heal/AL_HEAL, Magnus Exorcismus/PR_MAGNUS, or Meteor Storm/WZ_METEOR near it (MSC_SKILLUSED, skill IDs 18/89/28/79/83).
summons.amount_explanation: amount == the skill's SkillLevel (5); mob_summonslave rounds-robin the 3 valid candidates for `amount` iterations, so a single trigger spawns 5 adds: 2x Mimic, 2x Arclouse, 1x Khalitzburg.
summons.rate_per_attempt: 50.00% (Rate: 5000/10000) per qualifying event, subject to a 10000ms cooldown for that skill entry (Delay)

hp_threshold_behaviors.effect: Self-heals (server-configured heal formula, not derived here) once its own HP drops to 50% or below.

conditions: NPC_SUMMONMONSTER routes through the same mob_summonslave() handler as NPC_SUMMONSLAVE (src/map/skill.c case NPC_SUMMONSLAVE/NPC_SUMMONMONSTER); val0-val2 are a candidate monster-ID list, not a numeric range, and the summon count comes from the skill's own SkillLevel field, not from any val slot.
mob_summonslave() only accepts a candidate ID that mob_db_checkid() resolves; it stops scanning val0..val4 at the first invalid/zero slot, so only the 3 populated IDs here are ever candidates.

Each of the 8 listed source blocks is functionally identical (same candidates/amount/rate) but differs by which single MSC_* condition triggers it; they are listed together rather than duplicated per-condition.

entries.title: Moonlight Flower's Nine Tail summons and defensive kit

summons.amount_explanation: Single candidate, amount == SkillLevel (3): spawns 3 Nine Tail adds once, at boss spawn.

summons.trigger: Whenever it currently has 3 or fewer active slaves (MSC_SLAVELE, ConditionData 3), checked continuously in combat.
summons.amount_explanation: Single candidate, amount == SkillLevel (5): tops back up to 5 of this variant whenever its slave count falls to 3 or fewer.

hp_threshold_behaviors.effect: Self-heals at 30% HP or below.
Self-buffs (NPC_POWERUP) at 30% HP or below.
Casts an area silence centered on itself at 80% HP or below.
Drops Land Protector at 80% HP or below (suppresses ground-targeted magic near it).

conditions: The two summon entries use different monster IDs (1180 = plain Nine Tail on spawn, 1471 = the G_NINE_TAIL boss-adds variant on the slave-count trigger); they are not the same add.

entries.title: Beelzebub's Hell Fly/Chonchon swarm and low-HP flee

summons.trigger: Whenever it currently has 5 or fewer active slaves (MSC_SLAVELE, ConditionData 5).
summons.amount_explanation: amount == SkillLevel (10), round-robin over the 3-slot candidate list (Hell Fly appears twice, so it is weighted 2:1 over Chonchon): 10 adds are summoned per trigger, roughly 6-7 Hell Fly to 3-4 Chonchon depending on the round-robin start offset.

hp_threshold_behaviors.effect: Self-heals whenever below 99% HP -- effectively an almost-always-on heal.
Casts an area debuff field centered on itself at 50% HP or below.
Attempts to flee (walk 1 tile away, NPC_RUN skill_lv 1) at 1% HP or below.
Self-buffs Stoneskin at 5% HP or below.
Self-heals via life drain at 50% HP or below.
Casts an area soul-drain centered on itself at 50% HP or below.
Casts an area petrify centered on itself at 80% HP or below.

conditions: NPC_RUN with a self target makes the caster walk directly away from its facing direction (src/map/skill.c case NPC_RUN); it is a flee attempt, not a teleport or invulnerability phase.
